name: qz-agent-clusters
description: 15 purpose-built QA agents organised into four clusters: Intelligence, Design, Execution and Governance. Skills and agents are grouped by cluster at the marketplace root.

plugins.name: qa-intelligence
plugins.description: Perceive, retrieve, understand. Requirements refinement, change impact analysis, knowledge fabric curation and RAG-augmented authoring.

plugins.name: qa-design
plugins.description: Specify, scope, prepare. Test case design across functional, boundary, negative and edge-case dimensions, plus schema-aware synthetic test data.

plugins.name: qa-execution
plugins.description: Build, run, maintain, secure. Playwright automation, self-healing failure analysis, script maintenance, CI/CD gates, shift-left security and performance testing.

plugins.name: qa-governance
plugins.description: Validate, measure, improve. Defect enrichment with RCA, release-readiness metrics and dashboards, and a continuous learning feedback loop.
